spans.t: A convoy filled with much desirable
supplies should have arrived a moon
ago. Yet we dare not enter the
outskirts of the Weald. Can you brave the danger,
traverse the woods and find the convoy? What
happened to it? Are there any supplies that you
can bring back to us safe and intact?
